verdict.rationale: OCI documents IAM policies that govern resource access (a basis for narrow scoping) and token-based CLI authentication without a long-lived keypair, which hints at temporary credentials. Nothing in the pack describes agent-specific credential patterns or guarantees against privilege escalation. Missing for 10: documented agent-credential patterns, explicit short-lived scoped token issuance, anti-escalation guarantees/guardrails, hands-on or independent corroboration.
